prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If an object is approached, then pick it up and check its properties. If the object isn't visible, then move to it. Otherwise, scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
